statements.subject: client
statements.description: A client MAY issue a SETUP request for a stream that is already set up or playing in the session to change transport parameters, which a server MAY allow.
actions: issue SETUP request to change transport parameters

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If it does not allow the changing of parameters, it MUST respond with error 455 (Method Not Valid in This State).
actions: respond with error 455 (Method Not Valid in This State)

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If a client receives a 455 error when trying to change transport parameters while the server is in Play state, it MAY try to put the server in Ready state using PAUSE before issuing the SETUP request again.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: All transport parameters MAY be changed.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In a SETUP response for a request to change the transport parameters while in Play state, the server MUST include the Range header to indicate at what point the new transport parameters will be used.
actions: include Range header in SETUP response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Further, if RTP is used for delivery, the server MUST also include the RTP-Info header to indicate at what timestamp and RTP sequence number the change will take place.
actions: include RTP-Info header in SETUP response

statements.subject: message
statements.description: If both RTP-Info and Range are included in the response, the "rtp_time" parameter and start point in the Range header MUST be for the corresponding time, i.e., be used in the same way as for PLAY to ensure the correct synchronization information is available.
actions: set rtp_time parameter to correspond with Range header start point for synchronization

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the transport-parameters change that happened while in Play state results in a change of synchronization-related information, for example, changing RTP SSRC, the server MUST include the necessary synchronization information in the SETUP response.
actions: include necessary synchronization information in SETUP response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: However, the server SHOULD avoid changing the synchronization information if possible.
actions: avoid changing synchronization information when processing transport parameter change
